source_obligations.statement: Proposition 1. Let S be a set of recommendation policies described by finitely many linear constraints. If an optimal Problem-(2) policy rho* belongs to S and is the unique maximal-item-fairness-feasible policy in S, then rho* is recovered as the unique policy optimizer of the equality-form linear program L obtained by adding S to the constraints I_j(rho) = lambda for every item.
